text:
gabi: launching a focused bring-up for qx6b-int6 (code-heavy) — need curated prompt slice + dedupe + a 150-item golden smoke. goal: spot quality regressions vs q6b-hosted and qx4b-int4 before any canary.

tyler: sounds good. how do you want the slice stratified? code-lang distribution? token-length?

gabi: prioritize languages by traffic (py, js, go), then token-length buckets (short/med/long). add 50 adversarial truncation probes (end-of-file partial snippets) and 30 prompts with expected multi-file output.

rachel: label_ops - can you take the 150 golden with priority:quant-smoke? we'll need explicit code-correctness checks (compiles/linters) for the code set.

label_ops: yup. with 3 annotators we can do 150 golden in ~5 hrs if we include compile/linters. tagging as priority:quant-smoke now.

bench-bot: Benchmark job created: bench/qx6b-int6-code-smoke #217 by gabi. Artifacts will land at /artifacts/qx6b-int6/code-smoke/ :bar_chart:

tyler: dedupe plan: run normalized minhash shingle + exact fingerprint. threshold 0.82 for near-dup. command: `python tools/dedupe_shingle.py --in /tmp/qx6b-slice.json --out /tmp/qx6b-slice-dedup.json --thresh 0.82`

rachel: also run tokenizer-diff vs q6b-hosted to catch tokenization drift (emoji, byte sequences). small script: `tools/token_diff --base q6b-hosted --cand qx6b-int6 --in /tmp/dedup.json --out diffs.csv`

gabi: add an automated compile check for code outputs. if compile_failure_rate > 2% flag as regression. use `tools/compile_check.py --lang auto --in /evals/outputs.json --report /reports/compile.csv`

label_ops: note for annotators: when checking compile, prefer the smallest reproducible snippet and record exact error messages. set label_confidence if uncertain.

bench-bot: smoke run started. ETA ~45m for initial outputs. Logs: https://ci.redwood/run/217/logs

ops-bot: Deploy queued: canary/qx6b-int6-code #9 by gabi. Canary config: 1% traffic, auto-fallback to q6b-hosted disabled (manual flip).

tyler: metrics stub i'll use: sample_id, lang, prompt_tokens, baseline_compile_ok, qx4b_compile_ok, qx6b_compile_ok, perplexity_delta, token_overlap, regression_flag, notes. will push CSV to /reports/qx6b-int6-code/metrics.csv

gabi: perfect. after first 50 golden are done let's do a 20-min triage. if compile_ok delta falls >3% on high-traffic langs, we halt rollout.

rachel: adding an extra check for JSON-structured outputs (some prompts expect json)  use `jq` to validate and count malformed.

label_ops: starting prime batch of 50 now, will update when done. :white_check_mark:

gabi: thanks team  will post artifacts and quick summary when bench finishes.
